title: New York Lion:
title_short: New York Lion · Met Today in Our Hotel
headline: Two Lions who were strangers this morning tell the story of how they met in a hotel lobby.
story: A Lion from New York City and a Lion from Wichita, Kansas stand side by side. Atdhe asks how they know each other. They met today. He had just landed, saw a whole group walk into the hotel, thought “they're Lions”, and went over to say hi. That is the whole video: strangers become friends because they are Lions.

The last quarter ties it back. He is “ecstatic”, his family are Lions, and “a family that works together stays together”. She is “glad to be a Lion”. It must feel light, warm and fast. Friendship carries the cut, service is not the topic.
do: Open on frame 1 with Atdhe's question as top text: <q>How do you two know each other?</q>
Let the lobby story run in one breath. Cut the pauses, not the words.
Keep both people in frame while he tells the story. Her smile is the proof.
End on her line. Both people get a voice.
Use the third-generation lines only as a backup (see runners-up below).
dont: No logo, title or name card at 0:00. No name supers.
Don't use “we serve” or “working for humanity” lines. This cut is about friendship.
Don't make the convention the subject. The wall signs behind her are fine, don't zoom on them.
